messages:
Maria: Quick check — we need to lock SLA terms for Cerberus zone GPUs before next week's Dedicated pool rollout. Vendor quote says 99.5% uptime, we need 99.9. Any objections to pushing back on SLA?

Raj: pinged VendorX this morning. They said they can escalate to sales/legal. PO drafted but not sent.

VendorBot: PO #PO-8721 created (draft). Status: pending finance approval.

Simon: Finance will flag any >10% cost uplift for hot-standby. Do we actually need full hot-standby for initial launch? :thinking_face: 

Maria: Baseline numbers are small — we expect low QPS but strict p95. Putting sample targets here so everyone has same context:
```
expected_qps=150
p95_latency_target=120ms
models=chat+reranker
slots_needed=8 x a100
```

Kai: Can runtime mix reserved A100 with H100 spot for burst fallback? If so we could save cost and keep SLA on reserved portion only.

Raj: Yes technically, runtime routing can fallback to spot variants. But vendor SLA only covers dedicated/reserved machines — fallback would be best-effort.

Maria: OK — that means contract needs explicit wording: reserved pool SLA 99.9 + best-effort fallback. @Lisa can legal draft an addendum?

Lisa: On it. I need the vendor contact + proposed wording. Quick draft ETA: EOD tomorrow.

Simon: Also, finance asks we limit hot-standby window. Instead of 6h continuous standby, propose 2h standby with automated reprovision. Cuts cost.

Amy: @Simon — finance can approve if we reduce standby spend and keep unit rate within the current budget. Will need line-item on PO.

Tony-Vendor: From VendorX: we can offer a 5% hourly rate discount if you commit to a 3-month minimum. SLA addendum we can accept pending legal review.

Maria: 3 months OK from product. Raj, update the PO to standby-2h and include 3mo commit. Mark blocked until vendor signs.

Raj: Will update PO and add vendor email thread link. Current live quote pulled from vendor API (sanitized):
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" \
  "https://api.vendorx.com/v1/quotes/98765"
# response (trimmed):
{
  "quote_id": "98765",
  "hourly_a100": "12.50",
  "hot_standby_pct": "15"
}
```

VendorBot: PO updated -> PO-8721A (standby-2h). Status: awaiting vendor signature.

Simon: Noted. @Amy please confirm finance approval once PO shows final cost with standby reduction + 5% discount.

Amy: Approving conditionally — finance needs the final hourly line and total delta. I can sign off if net delta <= 8% above baseline.

Maria: Great. If vendor signs by end of day Friday we can schedule the cutover on Monday. Kai — can you run a smoke test Wed/Thu? Need A100 x4 for 30m.

Kai: Scheduling smoke test Thu 09:00 UTC, reserving A100 x4. Will post runbook.

Raj: PR #4821 will include PO id and the vendor SLA email once received. Leaving this thread as the single source of truth.

Maria: Thanks all. Blocking items: vendor signature + legal addendum + finance final sign-off. Please update here when you have a status change. :white_check_mark:
